description: Anonymized labeled test set for RentTrust v0.1. Scam-pattern cases are reconstructed from FTC-style red flags (deposit before viewing, irreversible payment, landlord abroad who cannot show the unit, duplicate/for-sale listings, refusal of viewing, well-below-median rent, urgency pressure). They are not real listings and name no real person. Legitimate cases are ordinary listings with no strong flags. No personal data, landlord contact details, or photos are included.
